clips.title: The story
paras: Nefarian's severed head is bound for Stormwind Keep after his defeat in Blackwing Lair. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon receives the trophy, a sign that the master of Blackrock Mountain has fallen. The victory is among the Alliance's greatest military triumphs in recent history.

Nefarian, brood-master of the Black Dragonflight and ruler of Upper Blackrock Spire, has long threatened the surrounding human kingdoms. His defeat ends his twisted experiments and schemes. Carrying his battle-scarred head back to Stormwind gives proof that the Lord of Blackrock has fallen to the Alliance's greatest heroes.

Highlord Bolvar Fordragon governs the kingdom from the throne room of Stormwind Keep. The dragon's severed head shocks the royal court and commands reverence. With the kingdom strained by internal political strife and threats from beyond, the victory lifts morale and earns a place in Alliance history.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The old feeling returns. The welcome pangs of victory reverberate throughout your being. Before you lies the monolithic, battle scarred head of Nefarian. Return it to your Highlord, champion.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You need not be told the meaning of what you have done, friend. This day will be recorded in the annals of history. A victory the likes of which has not been known to the Alliance for years - if ever!
